items.title: Nvidia, Coinbase, Skyworks, Axon, Tesla, Applied Aerospace, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  Stocks declined Tuesday as the yield reached its highest level in 19 years. Investor fears over the selloff in artificial-intelligence stocks eased somewhat. AI-related stocks fared better Tuesday after taking a battering on Monday following calls for a slowdown in AI development.

items.title: Ciena Rises 4% as Optics Selloff Unwinds; Coherent Edges Higher, Corning Holds Steady
items.summary: Ciena just bounced hard off a brutal month-long selloff, but Corning is barely moving while the broader market sits in the red. The divergence inside the optics sector points to something more specific than a simple reversal.

items.title: What Does Lumentum Holdings (LITE) Mean For Investors After The LITEON Token Launch?
items.summary: LITEON, a tokenized financial product tied to Lumentum Holdings (NasdaqGS:LITE), has been launched to give investors economic exposure to the stock. The new token links blockchain infrastructure with the AI optics theme that surrounds Lumentum's role in data center hardware. LITEON is structured to track Lumentum's share performance and referenced AI data center drivers without altering Lumentum's underlying operations or cash flows.
